name: trex-monorepo
description: 내 티라노사우루스 살려내!!! - 웹 기반 크로스플랫폼 팀 파티 게임

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared --if-present && npm run test -w backend --if-present && npm run test -w frontend --if-present
